## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use in projections rooted on the longer interval to state a shorter co-starting interval begins with it — the inverse view of a shared start.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly when [`gmeow:intervalStarts`](gmeow-intervalStarts.md) already states the relation; prefer the forward direction and read this as its inverse.

### How to use

- Let it follow by inversion from [`gmeow:intervalStarts`](gmeow-intervalStarts.md); NOT transitive (= [time:intervalStartedBy](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalStartedBy)).
